title: MEPS health-direction patterns differ by institutional friction route
source_unit: Two separate MEPS 2024 HC-256 person-level longitudinal descriptive screens: prescription delay and denial/prior-authorization delay

observations.period: 2024; round-4/2 prescription delay to round-5/3 perceived-health direction

denominator.unit: valid prescription-delay reporters with complete round-to-round perceived-health direction

observations.method: MEPS HC-256 round-4/2 prescription-delay report compared with ordinal perceived-health direction through round 5/3; standard BRR with 128 replicate flags.
observations.uncertainty: Source record preserves BRR standard errors and intervals; the route has no claim identifier, fill/adherence, treatment-continuity, payment, or household-response field.
observations.subgroup: Valid round-4/2 prescription-delay and round-5/3 perceived-health records.
observations.counterinterpretation: Medication need, severity, coverage, age, selection, and regression toward the mean can affect both delay reporting and health direction.

observations.period: 2024; round-5/3 denial or prior-authorization delay with round-4/2 to round-5/3 perceived-health direction

denominator.unit: valid denial/prior-authorization-delay reporters with complete round-to-round perceived-health direction

observations.method: MEPS HC-256 round-5/3 denial or prior-authorization-delay report compared with ordinal perceived-health direction from round 4/2 to 5/3; standard BRR with 128 replicate flags.
observations.uncertainty: Source record preserves BRR standard errors and intervals; the round-5/3 report is not proven to occur after the round-4/2 health endpoint and has no claim identifier or remedy field.
observations.subgroup: Valid round-5/3 denial/prior-authorization-delay and round-to-round perceived-health records.
observations.counterinterpretation: Underlying illness, service need, coverage, access, employment, selection, and timing ambiguity can generate the observed association.

boundary: These are separate, non-pooled longitudinal descriptive screens with different exposure definitions and clocks. They show that institutional friction is not one uniform health-direction mechanism; they do not establish causality, clinical recovery, treatment continuity, household adaptation, remedy, trust, action, switching, exit, or geopolitical consequence.
